subject: Accounting
question: A company pays the same monthly rent and wants Odoo to post the recurring journal entry automatically each month. Which feature should be used on the journal entry?
options: The Deferred Expense setting with Manually & Grouped
A payment term of 30 days
The 'Auto-post' field set to Monthly
A reconciliation model
explanation: Trường Auto-post (At Date/Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly) trên bút toán cho phép Odoo tự tạo và post bút toán định kỳ. Payment term chỉ dùng cho hạn thanh toán của hóa đơn.

subject: Accounting
question: A payment is registered on a customer invoice through a bank journal whose payment method uses an Outstanding Receipts account. The bank statement has not been imported yet. What is the invoice status?
options: In Payment
Posted
Paid
Partial
explanation: Khi thanh toán ghi nhận vào tài khoản Outstanding Receipts, hóa đơn ở trạng thái 'In Payment' cho đến khi dòng sao kê ngân hàng được đối soát với thanh toán, lúc đó mới chuyển thành 'Paid'.

subject: Accounting
question: What is the main benefit of Online Bank Synchronization in Odoo Accounting?
options: Vendor bills are digitized automatically from scanned PDFs sent by the bank
Customer invoices are automatically paid by SEPA direct debit mandates
Bank transactions are imported automatically, ready to be reconciled
The bank reconciles invoices on its side and sends the result to Odoo
explanation: Bank synchronization tự động nhập giao dịch ngân hàng vào journal Bank để người dùng đối soát trong Odoo. Số hóa hóa đơn (OCR) là tính năng khác.

subject: Accounting
question: A company receives about 40 customer checks every week and wants to deposit them together and match one single line on the bank statement. Which feature should be enabled?
options: Cash Basis
Analytic Distribution Models
Dedicated Credit Note Sequence
Batch Payments
explanation: Batch Payments gom nhiều khoản thanh toán thành một lô để đối soát với một dòng sao kê duy nhất. Các tính năng còn lại không liên quan đến gom thanh toán.

subject: Accounting
question: In the deferred revenue settings, which 'Based on' option makes the monthly amount vary according to the number of days in each month?
options: Months
Days
Manually & Grouped
Full Months
explanation: Với 'Days', số tiền phân bổ mỗi tháng thay đổi theo số ngày trong tháng. 'Months' chia đều theo tháng (chỉ prorate tháng lẻ), 'Full Months' coi mọi tháng bắt đầu là tháng đầy đủ.

subject: Accounting
question: A company sells a machine that is still being depreciated. What is the recommended way to record this in Odoo?
options: Use 'Modify Depreciation' to set the remaining value to zero on the sale date
Archive the asset and delete its remaining depreciation entries manually
Use 'Sell or Dispose' on the asset and link the customer invoice line
Create a credit note on the original vendor bill for the residual value
explanation: Nút 'Sell or Dispose' tạo bút toán thanh lý, tính lãi/lỗ dựa trên giá trị còn lại so với giá bán (hóa đơn bán phải được post trước). 'Modify Depreciation' dùng để tăng/giảm giá trị, không phải bán.

subject: Accounting
question: A fiscal position for intra-EU B2B customers maps 'VAT 21% (sales)' to 'VAT 0% EU'. What does this mapping do?
options: It converts all invoice amounts into the customer's currency at the daily rate
It replaces the default customer tax on all products permanently in their settings
It blocks invoices to EU customers who have no valid VAT number on their contact
On orders/invoices using this fiscal position, 21% is replaced by the 0% EU tax
explanation: Fiscal position ánh xạ thuế (và tài khoản) trên chứng từ khi được áp dụng, không thay đổi thuế mặc định trên sản phẩm. Việc đổi tiền tệ do pricelist/tiền tệ chứng từ quyết định.

subject: Accounting
question: A EUR-based company posts a vendor bill in GBP. Which exchange rate does Odoo use to compute the company-currency amounts of the bill?
options: The rate entered on the vendor's contact form
The rate valid at the bill/accounting date
The rate of the date when the bill will be paid
The average rate of the fiscal year
explanation: Odoo quy đổi theo tỷ giá có hiệu lực tại ngày chứng từ; chênh lệch khi thanh toán ở ngày khác được ghi bằng bút toán exchange difference. Không có tỷ giá trên form liên hệ.

subject: Accounting
question: A key customer must never receive automatic reminders; the account manager wants to handle follow-ups personally. Where is this set?
options: Delete the follow-up levels in Accounting ‣ Configuration ‣ Follow-up Levels
Set a credit limit of zero on the customer
Remove all payment terms from the customer's Sales & Purchase tab
On the customer form, set the follow-up Reminders to Manual
explanation: Trong tab Accounting của khách hàng, phần Invoice follow-ups cho phép chọn Automatic hoặc Manual và người phụ trách. Xóa follow-up levels sẽ ảnh hưởng tất cả khách hàng.

subject: Accounting
question: The 'Analytic' field is not visible on invoice lines in a new database. What must be done first?
options: Enable 'Analytic Accounting' in Accounting ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings
Install the Budget module
Create a cost-center journal
Activate developer mode
explanation: Trường Analytic Distribution chỉ xuất hiện khi bật Analytic Accounting trong Settings (mục Analytics). Developer mode không cần thiết cho việc này.

subject: Sales
question: A customer needs an invoice-like document before confirming the order so it can pay in advance. Which Sales setting allows sending this document?
options: Pro-Forma Invoice
Customer Addresses
Lock Confirmed Sales
Down Payments product
explanation: Pro-Forma Invoice cho phép gửi hóa đơn chiếu lệ từ báo giá mà không tạo bút toán kế toán. Lock Confirmed Sales chỉ khóa đơn đã xác nhận.

subject: Sales
question: A T-shirt has an attribute 'Size' with value 'XXL'. The XXL variant must cost 3 € more than the base price. Where is this configured?
options: In a separate product with its own sales price
As an optional product
As the Value Price Extra of the XXL value (via Configure on the product's Attributes & Variants tab)
On the customer's pricelist only
explanation: Value Price Extra trên giá trị thuộc tính cộng thêm vào giá bán khi chọn giá trị đó. Tạo sản phẩm riêng sẽ mất lợi ích quản lý variant.

subject: Sales
question: A sales manager wants to see the profit (sales price minus cost) on each quotation before confirming it. Which setting should be enabled?
options: Margins
Sale Warnings
Pro-Forma Invoice
Discounts
explanation: Margins hiển thị biên lợi nhuận trên dòng và tổng báo giá dựa trên giá vốn. Discounts chỉ thêm cột giảm giá.

subject: Sales
question: A B2B customer has a head office receiving invoices and several warehouses receiving goods. Which Sales setting makes the Invoice Address and Delivery Address fields available on quotations?
options: Pricelists
Multi-Warehouses
Dropshipping
Customer Addresses
explanation: Bật Customer Addresses cho phép chọn địa chỉ xuất hóa đơn và địa chỉ giao hàng riêng trên báo giá. Multi-Warehouses là kho của công ty, không phải địa chỉ khách hàng.

subject: Sales
question: A quotation is emailed to the customer with 'Send by Email'. What is its status after sending, before confirmation?
options: Sales Order
Locked
To Invoice
Quotation Sent
explanation: Sau khi gửi email, báo giá chuyển sang trạng thái 'Quotation Sent'; chỉ khi xác nhận mới thành 'Sales Order'. 'To Invoice' là trạng thái hóa đơn chứ không phải trạng thái đơn.

subject: Sales
question: A marketing team wants to generate 500 unique single-use codes, each giving 10% off, to distribute at a trade fair. Which program type fits best?
options: eWallet
Coupons
Promotions
Loyalty Cards
explanation: Chương trình Coupons sinh ra các mã riêng, dùng một lần để phân phát. Promotions áp dụng tự động theo điều kiện, không cần sinh mã riêng cho từng người.

subject: Sales
question: In Odoo 18, what happens when a salesperson adds a product that has optional products configured to a quotation line?
options: The optional products are added automatically with quantity 1
A configurator dialog proposes the optional products
Odoo blocks the line until optional products are selected
Nothing; optional products only appear on the customer invoice
explanation: Khi sản phẩm có optional products, product configurator hiện lên để đề xuất thêm các sản phẩm tùy chọn. Chúng không tự động được thêm vào đơn.

subject: Sales
question: A pricelist rule should give 15% off a product only when a customer orders at least 50 units. Which field of the rule handles this?
options: Price Extra
Validity end date
Min. Quantity
Rounding Method
explanation: Min. Quantity trên quy tắc pricelist làm quy tắc chỉ áp dụng khi số lượng đặt đạt ngưỡng. Price Extra thuộc về giá trị thuộc tính variant.

subject: Sales
question: A consulting firm sells a service whose hours are tracked in the Timesheets app, and wants to invoice exactly the hours recorded. Which invoicing policy should be set on the service product?
options: Based on Timesheets
Prepaid/Fixed Price
Based on Milestones
Ordered quantities with a down payment
explanation: Based on Timesheets lấy số giờ ghi nhận trên timesheet làm số lượng đã giao để lập hóa đơn. Prepaid/Fixed Price lập hóa đơn theo số lượng đặt bất kể giờ thực tế.

subject: Purchase
question: The default Bill Control policy in Purchase settings is 'Received quantities', but one subscription service must be billed on ordered quantities. What should be done?
options: Create the bill from Accounting without a PO
Use a call for tenders
Change the Control Policy on that product's Purchase tab
Change the global setting each time
explanation: Chính sách trong Settings chỉ là mặc định cho sản phẩm mới; có thể ghi đè bằng trường Control Policy trên tab Purchase của từng sản phẩm.

subject: Purchase
question: Under the 'Received quantities' policy, a user clicks 'Create Bill' on a confirmed PO before anything is received. What happens?
options: Odoo raises an error since there is nothing to bill
The receipt is automatically validated
A bill for the full ordered quantity is created
A bill with a 'To Approve' status is created
explanation: Với Received quantities, chưa nhận hàng thì không có gì để lập hóa đơn nên Odoo báo lỗi. Odoo không tự xác nhận phiếu nhập kho.

subject: Purchase
question: A buyer wants Odoo to automatically email selected vendors a few days before the expected arrival date to confirm the delivery. Which feature is used?
options: Receipt Reminder
Lock Confirmed Orders
Follow-up Levels
Purchase Order Approval
explanation: Receipt Reminder gửi email cho nhà cung cấp trước ngày dự kiến nhận hàng (số ngày cấu hình được). Follow-up Levels là nhắc nợ khách hàng trong Accounting.

subject: Purchase
question: A buyer creates a blanket order, adds products and quantities but leaves the Unit Price empty, and leaves 'Agreement Validity' empty. What is the result?
options: The agreement cannot be confirmed without an end date
Confirming fails until every line has a unit price
Prices are taken from the product's sales price at confirmation
Prices are copied from the product cost, and the agreement expires after one year
explanation: Khi bấm Confirm, Odoo 18 báo lỗi "You cannot confirm a blanket order with lines missing a price.", vì mọi dòng của blanket order phải có Unit Price lớn hơn 0. Agreement Validity thì không bắt buộc: để trống nghĩa là thỏa thuận không có ngày hết hạn, nên đáp án "cần ngày kết thúc" là sai.

subject: Purchase
question: A buyer already has two independent RFQs for the same need, created before she learned about alternatives. How can she group them for comparison?
options: It is not possible; only new alternatives can be compared
Duplicate one into a blanket order
Merge them with the Replenishment report
From the Alternatives tab of one RFQ, use 'Link to Existing RfQ'
explanation: 'Link to Existing RfQ' trong tab Alternatives liên kết RFQ có sẵn làm phương án thay thế để so sánh. Không cần tạo lại RFQ mới.

subject: Purchase
question: A product has the 'Buy' and 'Replenish on Order (MTO)' routes. A sales order for it is confirmed. What does Odoo generate?
options: Nothing until a reordering rule is triggered
A manufacturing order for the quantity sold
An RFQ to the product's vendor
A draft vendor bill for the vendor
explanation: Kết hợp MTO và Buy khiến Odoo tạo RFQ cho nhà cung cấp ngay khi xác nhận đơn bán. Không cần reordering rule.

subject: Purchase
question: Where is the vendor's delivery lead time entered so that Odoo can compute the expected arrival date on RFQs?
options: In the Purchase Order Approval setting, as a minimum delay
On the vendor's Accounting tab, next to the bank accounts
On the vendor payment term, as the number of days due
In the Delivery Lead Time of the product's vendor line
explanation: Delivery Lead Time trên dòng vendor pricelist được dùng để tính ngày dự kiến nhận hàng và thời điểm đặt hàng. Payment term chỉ liên quan đến thanh toán.

subject: Purchase
question: A product is sold by the unit but bought from the vendor in boxes of 12. How is this handled in Odoo 18?
options: Create two different products and link them with a kit BoM
Enable Units of Measure and set a different Purchase UoM on the product
Use a variant attribute 'Box of 12' with a price extra
Set a minimum quantity of 12 on the vendor pricelist line of the product
explanation: Với Units of Measure bật, sản phẩm có thể có Purchase UoM khác đơn vị bán; Odoo tự quy đổi khi nhập kho. Tạo hai sản phẩm riêng gây khó khăn quản lý tồn kho.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: A user types =PIVOT(1,,0) in an empty cell. What does this produce?
options: Only the first value of pivot 1, in the active cell
A dynamic pivot table of pivot 1, without totals
An error, because PIVOT requires a measure name as argument
A static copy of pivot 1 pasted as plain values
explanation: PIVOT là hàm mảng tạo pivot động tự mở rộng; tham số include_total = 0 bỏ dòng/cột tổng. Lấy một giá trị đơn lẻ dùng PIVOT.VALUE.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: A sales dashboard must show each salesperson only their own figures by default. Which global filter setup helps?
options: A Text filter in which each user types their own name
Separate copies of the spreadsheet shared with each salesperson
A Date filter with a relative period such as 'This month'
A User relation filter defaulting to the current user
explanation: Relation filter trên model User có tùy chọn mặc định lọc theo người dùng hiện tại. Text filter yêu cầu nhập tay, Date filter không lọc theo người dùng.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: A user uploads an Excel (.xlsx) file to Documents and opens it with Odoo Spreadsheet. By default, what happens to the original .xlsx file?
options: It is converted into a spreadsheet template in the Documents app
It is shared externally with the users who can access the folder
It is sent to the trash, unless 'Send source file to trash' is disabled
It is kept in the same folder and stays linked live to the new spreadsheet
explanation: Khi mở file xlsx bằng Odoo Spreadsheet, file gốc mặc định bị chuyển vào thùng rác; có thể tắt 'Send source file to trash' để giữ lại. File gốc không liên kết động với spreadsheet.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: A viewer opens a shared spreadsheet that has cell comments added by editors. What does the viewer see?
options: All comments, in read-only mode without the reply box
No comments; only Owners and Editors see comments
Only the comments in which they are mentioned with @
Only resolved comments, kept as a read-only history
explanation: Comments chỉ dành cho Owner và Editor; Viewer không thấy comment. Comment đã resolve vẫn nằm trong panel Comments cho Owner/Editor.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: An administrator wants to customize the standard Sales dashboard without losing the changes at the next Odoo upgrade. What is recommended?
options: Edit the standard dashboard directly; changes are kept on upgrade
Download it as .xlsx, edit it in Excel and re-upload it over the original
Use File ‣ Make a copy and customize the copy
Save it as a template, then delete the original
explanation: Dashboard chuẩn được cài lại ở mỗi lần nâng cấp phiên bản nên sửa trực tiếp sẽ mất thay đổi; nên tạo bản sao (Make a copy) rồi tùy chỉnh.

subject: Spreadsheet
question: In a dynamic pivot's properties panel, a manager wants a new measure 'Margin %' computed from two existing measures. What can be used?
options: Add a calculated measure in the Measures section
Use Flip axes so the measures are combined into one column
Create a new field in the Sales model with Studio only
Add a Text global filter named 'Margin %' to the pivot
explanation: Trong mục Measures có thể Add calculated measure, nhập công thức bắt đầu bằng '=' và chọn cách tổng hợp. Flip axes chỉ hoán đổi hàng và cột.

subject: Inventory
question: You create a new warehouse with the Short Name 'SG'. What does Odoo create automatically?
options: A location hierarchy (e.g. SG/Stock) plus operation types and routes
Only operation types; the SG/Stock location must be created manually
Only a view location; operation types must be created manually
A new company named SG, with its own chart of accounts
explanation: Khi tạo warehouse, Odoo tự sinh view location SG, các sub-location như SG/Stock và các operation type/route tương ứng. Không cần tạo thủ công và không tạo company mới.

subject: Inventory
question: Which location type is used only to structure the location hierarchy and cannot contain products?
options: Internal Location
Inventory Loss
View
Transit Location
explanation: Location loại View chỉ dùng để tổ chức cây vị trí (ví dụ WH), không chứa hàng. Internal Location là nơi chứa tồn kho thực.

subject: Inventory
question: High-value shelves must be counted every 30 days, with count dates scheduled automatically. What should be configured?
options: Create a reordering rule with a 30-day lead time
Set the Annual Inventory Day and Month in the Inventory settings
Set the Inventory Frequency (days) to 30 on those locations
Set a removal strategy on the shelves
explanation: Inventory Frequency trên location tự động đặt ngày kiểm kê theo chu kỳ (cycle count). Annual Inventory Day and Month chỉ áp dụng cho kiểm kê hằng năm toàn công ty.

subject: Inventory
question: Which removal strategy picks products from the location whose name comes first in alphanumeric order?
options: Closest Location
Least Packages
First In, First Out (FIFO)
Last In, First Out (LIFO)
explanation: Closest Location ưu tiên lấy hàng từ location có tên đứng trước theo thứ tự chữ-số. Least Packages ưu tiên lấy từ ít package nhất, không theo tên location.

subject: Inventory
question: A reordering rule has its Trigger set to 'Manual'. What is the behaviour?
options: An RFQ is created and confirmed immediately when stock drops below the minimum
The scheduler creates the order once a day as with an 'Auto' trigger
The rule is ignored everywhere, including the Replenishment report
Nothing runs automatically; a user orders it from the Replenishment report
explanation: Trigger Manual nghĩa là scheduler không tự tạo RFQ/MO; người dùng xem nhu cầu ở Replenishment và bấm đặt hàng. Tự động chạy theo scheduler là hành vi của trigger Auto.

subject: Inventory
question: A product uses FIFO. You receive 5 units at $8, then 5 units at $12. You then deliver 6 units. What is the value of the delivered goods?
explanation: FIFO xuất các đơn vị nhập trước: 5 × $8 + 1 × $12 = $52. $60 là cách tính bình quân (AVCO), không phải FIFO.

subject: Inventory
question: A product category uses Inventory Valuation = 'Manual'. What does this mean?
options: The costing method is forced to Standard Price and cannot be changed
Every stock move posts a journal entry to the stock valuation account in real time
Vendor bills cannot be created for these products until they are received
Stock moves create no journal entries; the accountant values stock manually
explanation: Manual (periodic) không sinh bút toán khi có stock move, kế toán tự ghi nhận giá trị tồn kho định kỳ. Ghi bút toán thời gian thực là chế độ Automated.

subject: Inventory
question: Freight costs on a receipt must be distributed among the products according to how heavy each one is. Which split method should be used on the landed cost line?
options: By Current Cost
By Weight
Equal
By Quantity
explanation: Split method By Weight phân bổ chi phí theo trọng lượng sản phẩm. Equal chia đều cho các dòng bất kể khối lượng.

subject: Inventory
question: Warehouse B must be replenished from Warehouse A. What is the quickest way to set this up (Multi-Step Routes enabled)?
options: Set 'Resupply From' to Warehouse A on Warehouse B's form
Create a putaway rule from Warehouse A to Warehouse B
Enable the Dropship route on the products, with Warehouse A as vendor
Create a vendor contact for Warehouse A and buy from it with RFQs
explanation: Trường Resupply From trên warehouse tự tạo route tiếp hàng giữa các kho, dùng được trên sản phẩm hoặc reordering rule. Putaway rule chỉ hoạt động bên trong một kho khi nhập hàng.

subject: Inventory
question: Putaway rules must not store more than 500 kg on a given rack. What should be configured?
options: A removal strategy on the rack location with a 500 kg limit
A Storage Category (max weight) on the rack location
A reordering rule on the rack location with a Max Quantity of 500
A Package Type with a maximum weight of 500 kg for the rack
explanation: Storage Category cho phép giới hạn tải trọng/sức chứa của location, và putaway rule sẽ bỏ qua location đã đầy. Package Type mô tả bao bì, không giới hạn sức chứa của kệ.

subject: Manufacturing
question: A manufacturing order should be considered ready as soon as the components needed for its first operation are available. Which BoM field should be set?
options: Operation Dependencies ticked
Manufacturing Readiness = 'When components for 1st operation are available'
Manufacturing Lead Time = 0
Flexible Consumption = 'Allowed'
explanation: Manufacturing Readiness quyết định MO được coi là sẵn sàng khi đủ toàn bộ component hay chỉ cần đủ component cho operation đầu tiên. Flexible Consumption liên quan đến số lượng tiêu thụ, không phải tình trạng sẵn sàng.

subject: Manufacturing
question: A confirmed manufacturing order contains work orders. Which button schedules these work orders on the work centers' calendars?
options: Plan
Check availability
Produce All
Unlock
explanation: Nút Plan lên lịch các work order theo công suất và lịch của work center. Check availability chỉ kiểm tra/giữ component.

subject: Manufacturing
question: With subcontracting, components must automatically be sent from your warehouse to the subcontractor when you purchase the finished product. Which route should be set on the components?
options: Resupply Subcontractor on Order
Replenish on Order (MTO)
Manufacture
Dropship
explanation: Route Resupply Subcontractor on Order tạo phiếu xuất component từ kho đến subcontractor khi PO thành phẩm được xác nhận. Dropship dùng khi nhà cung cấp giao thẳng cho khách.

subject: Manufacturing
question: You want to update a manufactured product's cost based on its components and operations. What can you use?
options: Create an ECO on the BoM
Validate a landed cost on the last receipt
Change the costing method to AVCO
The 'Compute Price from BoM' action on the product form
explanation: Compute Price from BoM tính lại giá vốn từ chi phí component và chi phí operation (work center). Đổi costing method hay landed cost không tính giá từ BoM.

subject: Manufacturing
question: Which application must be installed to manage engineering change orders (ECOs) and BoM versions?
options: Quality
Documents
PLM
Approvals
explanation: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) quản lý ECO và các phiên bản BoM/operation. Approvals là app phê duyệt chung, không quản lý phiên bản BoM.

subject: Manufacturing
question: Expected operation durations should be updated automatically from the times actually recorded on past work orders. What should be set on the operation?
options: Duration Computation = 'Set duration manually'
Time Efficiency = 100% on the work center
Capacity = 1 on the work center
Duration Computation = 'Compute based on tracked time'
explanation: Compute based on tracked time tính thời lượng dự kiến từ thời gian thực tế của các work order trước. 'Set duration manually' giữ nguyên giá trị nhập tay.

subject: Manufacturing
question: A by-product should absorb 10% of the production cost. Where do you configure this?
options: In the cost per hour of the work center used for the by-product
In the analytic distribution of the BoM's by-product line
In the by-product line's 'Cost Share (%)' on the BoM
With a landed cost on the manufacturing order of the product
explanation: Cost Share (%) trên dòng by-product phân bổ một phần chi phí sản xuất cho sản phẩm phụ. Chi phí work center chỉ tính chi phí vận hành, không phân bổ giữa các sản phẩm.

subject: Manufacturing
question: During production, a component is damaged and cannot be used. How do you record it on the manufacturing order?
options: Archive the component product
Use the Scrap button on the MO for the damaged component
Create an unbuild order for the component from the MO
Return the component to its vendor from the original receipt
explanation: Nút Scrap trên MO chuyển component hỏng sang scrap location và giữ liên kết với MO. Unbuild chỉ dùng để tháo dỡ thành phẩm đã sản xuất.

subject: Point of Sale
question: During an open session, a cashier takes money from the drawer to pay a delivery person. How should this be recorded?
options: Close the session and reopen it with a new opening balance
Create a refund order for the amount
Record it later as an expense in the Expenses app
Use 'Cash In/Out' from the PoS menu and enter the reason
explanation: Cash In/Out ghi nhận tiền rút/nạp vào két trong phiên kèm lý do, giúp đối chiếu khi đóng session. Refund order là trả hàng cho khách, không phải chi tiền mặt.

subject: Point of Sale
question: Where do you link a payment terminal (e.g. Adyen, Stripe) to a Point of Sale in Odoo 18?
options: On the customer's contact form, Sales & Purchase tab
On the bank journal of the shop, in the Bank Account field
On the PoS payment method ('Use a Payment Terminal')
In the PoS settings, in the receipt header and footer section
explanation: Sau khi bật terminal tương ứng trong PoS settings, chọn terminal ở trường Use a Payment Terminal trên payment method. Journal ngân hàng không chứa cấu hình thiết bị thanh toán.

subject: Point of Sale
question: A restaurant wants drinks to be printed at the bar and food at the kitchen. Which setting should be used?
options: Self-service invoicing
Customer Display
Preparation Printers, each linked to product categories
Preparation Display with a single screen for all categories
explanation: Preparation Printers cho phép gán product category cho từng máy in để món in đúng nơi chế biến. Customer Display là màn hình cho khách xem.

subject: Point of Sale
question: A shop runs a 'buy 2, get 1 free' offer on socks in the PoS. Which Discount & Loyalty program type is designed for this?
options: Buy X Get Y
eWallet
Gift Card
Next Order Coupons
explanation: Buy X Get Y tặng sản phẩm miễn phí khi mua đủ số lượng điều kiện. Next Order Coupons phát coupon dùng cho lần mua sau, không áp dụng ngay.

subject: Point of Sale
question: A store wants customers who spend more than $100 to receive a coupon usable on their next purchase. Which program type should be used?
options: Next Order Coupons
Promotions
Discount Code
Loyalty Cards
explanation: Next Order Coupons phát coupon cho khách khi đơn đạt điều kiện, dùng ở lần mua tiếp theo. Promotions giảm giá ngay trên đơn hiện tại.

subject: Point of Sale
question: Customers should be able to request an invoice themselves after purchase, using information printed on their receipt. Which setting enables this?
options: Kiosk self-ordering mode
Self-service invoicing
Flexible Pricelists
Customer Account payment method
explanation: "Self-service invoicing" (Point of Sale ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings) in mã QR và mã duy nhất trên phiếu để khách tự yêu cầu hóa đơn qua portal. Customer Account là phương thức ghi nợ, không liên quan đến việc khách tự xuất hóa đơn.

subject: Point of Sale
question: 'Log in with Employees' is enabled, but the 'Employees with basic access' and 'Employees with manager access' lists are left empty. Who can log in to the PoS?
options: Only employees linked to a user account
All employees
Only the PoS managers
Nobody
explanation: Theo cấu hình, nếu để trống danh sách nhân viên thì tất cả employee đều đăng nhập được vào PoS. Không có nghĩa là chặn toàn bộ.

subject: Point of Sale
question: A restaurant applies different taxes for takeaway and eat-in orders. Which PoS setting should be used?
options: Tax-included prices on products
Flexible Pricelists
Two separate products for each dish
Eat in / Take out
explanation: Trong Odoo 18, nhà hàng bật "Eat in / Take out" và chọn một Alternative Fiscal Position; nhân viên đánh dấu đơn mang đi để Odoo đổi sang thuế tương ứng (giá phải là giá đã gồm thuế). Pricelist chỉ thay đổi giá, không thay đổi thuế.

subject: CRM
question: When converting a lead into an opportunity, what extra option does the conversion wizard offer besides choosing the customer and salesperson?
options: Create an invoice for the expected revenue
Directly confirm a sales order
Send a mass mailing to the lead
Merge the lead with existing similar opportunities
explanation: Wizard Convert to Opportunity cho phép chọn "Merge with existing opportunities" khi có bản ghi tương tự, cùng với chọn team/salesperson và khách hàng. Wizard không tạo sales order hay hóa đơn.

subject: CRM
question: A sales manager wants to see expected revenue grouped by expected closing month. Which report is designed for this?
options: CRM ‣ Reporting ‣ Lead Mining Requests
CRM ‣ Reporting ‣ Activities
CRM ‣ Reporting ‣ Forecast
CRM ‣ Configuration ‣ Sales Teams
explanation: Báo cáo Forecast hiển thị opportunity theo Expected Closing (theo tháng) để dự báo doanh thu. Báo cáo Activities phân tích hoạt động, không nhóm theo ngày đóng dự kiến.

subject: CRM
question: A salesperson manually changes the probability of an opportunity that uses Predictive Lead Scoring. What happens next?
options: Odoo refuses the change because the probability field is read-only
It keeps the manual value until the user switches back to automated
The manual value is applied to all opportunities in the same stage
The manual value is overwritten by the automated one at the next stage change
explanation: Khi sửa tay, opportunity không còn dùng xác suất tự động; một nút (biểu tượng bánh răng) xuất hiện để quay về automated probability. Probability không phải read-only.

subject: CRM
question: Several duplicate opportunities are merged with the Merge wizard. What is the result?
options: One opportunity remains with the merged data and chatter; the others are deleted
All records are kept and linked together as "siblings" of the oldest one
All records are archived and a new opportunity is created with all their data
Only the chatter messages are copied over; the duplicates stay active in the pipeline
explanation: Merge gộp thông tin và lịch sử chatter vào một bản ghi duy nhất, các bản ghi còn lại bị xóa. Odoo không giữ song song các bản trùng sau khi gộp.

subject: CRM
question: In the pipeline Kanban view, the activity (clock) icon of an opportunity is red. What does it mean?
options: The next scheduled activity is overdue
The activity is due today
The opportunity has no activity scheduled
The opportunity's probability is below 10%
explanation: Màu biểu tượng activity: đỏ = quá hạn, cam = đến hạn hôm nay, xanh lá = trong tương lai. Không có activity thì biểu tượng màu xám.

subject: CRM
question: A company has two sales teams and wants a pipeline stage that only one of them uses. How is this done?
options: Archive the stage so that it disappears from the other team's pipeline
Fold the stage in the other team's Kanban view so it is hidden
Set the Sales Team field on the stage (developer mode)
Create the stage in CRM ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings for one team
explanation: Stage có field Sales Team; nếu điền team thì stage chỉ hiển thị trong pipeline của team đó, để trống thì dùng chung. Fold chỉ thu gọn cột, stage vẫn tồn tại cho mọi team.

subject: CRM
question: What is the purpose of the "Requirements" field on a CRM stage?
options: It blocks moving an opportunity to the stage until the listed fields are filled
It sets the default probability of opportunities entering the stage
It defines which salespeople can see the stage
It describes internal requirements, shown as a tooltip on the stage name
explanation: Requirements chỉ là ghi chú nội bộ, hiển thị dạng tooltip khi rê chuột lên tên stage; nó không ép buộc điều kiện nào. Odoo không chặn chuyển stage dựa vào field này.

subject: CRM
question: A company wants each submission of its website "Contact Us" form to appear in the CRM. What should be configured?
options: Enable Lead Mining in CRM settings to import the submissions
Set the form's Action to "Create an Opportunity" in the website editor
Set the form's Action to "Send an E-mail" to the salesperson's address
Enable Predictive Lead Scoring
explanation: Trong website editor, form building block có field Action; chọn "Create an Opportunity" để mỗi lần gửi form tạo lead/opportunity trong CRM. "Send an E-mail" chỉ gửi email, không tạo bản ghi CRM.

subject: Marketing
question: In Email Marketing, how can a marketer reuse the design of a successful past mailing for future mailings?
options: Export the mailing as HTML and import it in Email Marketing settings
Save it as a Marketing Automation activity
Mark it as a favorite (star) so it appears among the templates
Duplicate the mailing list it was sent to
explanation: Mailing được đánh dấu Favorite (ngôi sao) sẽ xuất hiện trong danh sách mẫu khi chọn giao diện cho mailing mới. Nhân bản mailing list chỉ sao chép danh sách người nhận.

subject: Marketing
question: In Marketing Automation, an activity has a "Validity Duration" of 2 days. What does this mean?
options: The activity is repeated every 2 days until the campaign is stopped
If it cannot run within 2 days of its scheduled time, it is cancelled
The participant is removed from the campaign 2 days after entering it
The email links expire after 2 days
explanation: Validity Duration giới hạn thời gian cho phép thực thi activity; quá hạn mà chưa chạy được thì activity bị hủy cho participant đó. Nó không lặp lại activity hay làm hết hạn link.

subject: Marketing
question: A company has a Facebook page and a LinkedIn page connected to Social Marketing. How can it publish the same announcement on both?
options: Publish on Facebook and enable automatic sharing to LinkedIn in Settings
Create two posts, one per account; a post can only target one account
Use Email Marketing with social accounts as recipients
Create one social post and select both accounts in the post
explanation: Một bài Social Marketing có thể chọn nhiều tài khoản cùng lúc (Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Instagram…), có thể chỉnh preview riêng. Không cần tạo bài riêng cho từng tài khoản.

subject: Marketing
question: How can an event organiser automatically send a reminder email to all attendees 3 days before the event?
options: In the event's Communication tab, add the reminder 3 days before the event
Use the "Use Event Barcode" setting
Schedule a 'Reminder' activity on each registration 3 days before
Create a mass mailing to the registrations and send it manually 3 days before
explanation: Tab Communication của event là lịch gửi email/SMS tự động theo mốc (sau đăng ký, trước/sau sự kiện). Gửi mass mailing thủ công cũng được nhưng không tự động.

subject: Marketing
question: At the event entrance, staff want to check attendees in by scanning the barcode on their tickets. What is needed?
options: Enable "Use Event Barcode" and scan from the Registration Desk
Print badges from Email Marketing and check them by hand
Install the Barcode app and scan tickets as receipts in a warehouse
Enable "Booth Management" and scan tickets at each booth
explanation: Bật "Use Event Barcode" để vé/badge có barcode và dùng Registration Desk để quét check-in. Barcode của Inventory phục vụ kho, không phải check-in sự kiện.

subject: Marketing
question: A marketer prints a flyer and wants a short URL whose clicks are tracked with campaign, medium and source. Which tool should be used?
options: Predictive Lead Scoring
A mailing list
Link Tracker
A Marketing Automation campaign
explanation: Link Tracker tạo link rút gọn gắn tham số UTM (campaign, medium, source) và đếm số click. Marketing Automation dùng cho workflow gửi thông điệp, không tạo link rút gọn.

subject: Marketing
question: In the statistics of a sent mailing, what does a "Bounced" email mean?
options: The recipient marked the email as spam and unsubscribed
The recipient opened the email but did not click on any link
The email was delivered to the recipient's spam folder
The email could not be delivered to the recipient's mailbox
explanation: Bounced nghĩa là email bị server người nhận trả về, không giao được (địa chỉ sai, hộp thư đầy…). Email vào thư mục spam vẫn được tính là đã giao.

subject: Marketing
question: An A/B test is configured on 20% of recipients with winner selection "Highest Click Rate". What happens on the "Send Final On" date?
options: All versions are sent again to every recipient of the mailing list
The best-performing version is sent automatically to the rest
The marketer must pick the winner manually before anything is sent
The test is cancelled if fewer than 50% of the test group clicked
explanation: Nếu tiêu chí khác Manual, đến ngày Send Final On Odoo tự chọn phiên bản tốt nhất và gửi cho phần người nhận còn lại. Chỉ khi chọn Manual thì người dùng mới phải tự chọn winner.

subject: Survey
question: During a live session, the host wants participants who answer faster to earn more points. Which option enables this?
options: Randomized per Section
Scoring without answers
Survey Time Limit
Reward quick answers
explanation: "Reward quick answers" cho thêm điểm khi trả lời nhanh trong live session (kèm giới hạn thời gian mỗi câu). Survey Time Limit giới hạn tổng thời gian, không cộng điểm.

subject: Survey
question: A Matrix question lists several products as rows and satisfaction levels as columns. The respondent must be able to tick several columns per row. Which setting is required?
options: Question type: Multiple choice: multiple answers allowed
Matrix Type: "Multiple choices per row"
Question type: Scale
Matrix Type: "One choice per row"
explanation: Câu hỏi Matrix có Matrix Type; chọn "Multiple choices per row" để tick nhiều cột trên mỗi dòng. Multiple choice thường không có dạng dòng × cột.

subject: Survey
question: When creating a survey in Odoo 18, which survey type disables scoring, certification and time limit by default?
options: Survey
Assessment
Live session
Custom
explanation: Loại Survey dùng để thu thập ý kiến nên mặc định tắt scoring, certification và time limit. Assessment dành cho bài đánh giá có chấm điểm.

subject: Survey
question: Respondents complain they cannot return to a previous page to change an answer. Which option should be enabled?
options: Randomized per Section
Require Login
Users can go back
Conditional display
explanation: Tùy chọn "Users can go back" (Back Button) cho phép quay lại trang trước. Require Login chỉ bắt đăng nhập trước khi làm.

subject: Survey
question: A question must be answered before the respondent can continue. What should be set?
options: Set the survey Access Mode to "Invited people only"
Enable "Survey Time Limit" on the survey options
Add a conditional display on the question
Tick "Mandatory Answer" on the question
explanation: "Mandatory Answer" trong tab Options của câu hỏi buộc phải trả lời, có thể kèm thông báo lỗi. Conditional display chỉ quyết định câu hỏi có hiển thị hay không.

subject: Survey
question: What does the "Certified Email Template" option on a certification do?
options: Emails the certification document to participants who pass
Sends the results to the survey responsible after each attempt
Sends a retry reminder to participants who failed the certification
Sends the invitation link to all participants
explanation: Certified Email Template là email tự động gửi cho người đậu certification, kèm file chứng chỉ. Việc mời người làm survey dùng wizard Share/Invite.

subject: Website
question: A consultant wants customers to book a meeting with her directly from the website. Which app is needed?
options: Live Chat
Calendar only, by sharing her Odoo calendar link
Events, with free tickets for each time slot
Appointments, with a published appointment type
explanation: App Appointments cho phép tạo appointment type, publish lên website để khách tự chọn khung giờ trống. Events dùng cho sự kiện có đăng ký, không phải đặt lịch hẹn 1-1.

subject: Website
question: A designer wants to change the font and main colours of the whole website at once. Which part of the website editor is used?
options: The Theme tab
The Blocks tab
The Customize tab of a selected block
Site ‣ Pages
explanation: Tab Theme chứa thiết lập toàn cục (màu, font, nút, layout). Tab Customize chỉ chỉnh building block đang được chọn.

subject: Website
question: The website already has a second language installed. How do you translate the text of a page into that language?
options: Export a .po file from the website editor and re-import it
Switch to that language and click "Translate" to edit inline
Duplicate the page and rename its URL with the language code
Edit the page in the default language; Odoo translates automatically
explanation: Chuyển sang ngôn ngữ cần dịch trên website rồi bấm Translate để sửa trực tiếp các đoạn văn bản. Nhân bản trang tạo nội dung trùng, không gắn với bản gốc.

subject: Website
question: In a multi-website database, a landing page must only be shown on one of the websites. What should be done?
options: Unpublish the page
Set Visibility to "Restricted Group"
Set the Website field of the page to that website
Remove the page from the sitemap
explanation: Trang có field Website; chọn website cụ thể thì trang chỉ có trên website đó, để trống thì dùng chung. Unpublish sẽ ẩn trang khỏi tất cả khách truy cập.

subject: Website
question: A thank-you page should stay published but should not appear in search engine results or the sitemap. What should be done?
options: Unpublish the page
Set Visibility to "Signed In"
Remove its meta description
Uncheck "Indexed" in the page properties
explanation: Bỏ tick "Indexed" giúp trang không bị search engine index và không xuất hiện trong sitemap nhưng vẫn truy cập được. Unpublish thì khách không xem được trang.

subject: Website
question: Where do you upload the small icon (favicon) shown in the browser tab for the website?
options: In the company logo field of Settings ‣ Companies
Website ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings, Favicon field
In the website editor, Blocks tab
In Site ‣ Optimize SEO
explanation: Favicon được upload trong Website settings. Logo công ty hiển thị trên header/báo cáo, không phải favicon.

subject: Website
question: A new page has been created but is still unpublished. Who can see it?
options: Only logged-in portal users
Nobody, not even administrators, until it is published
Only users with website editing (designer) rights
All visitors with the URL, but it is not listed in the menu
explanation: Trang chưa publish chỉ hiển thị với user nội bộ có quyền chỉnh sửa website (Restricted Editor/Editor and Designer). Khách truy cập và portal user không xem được.

subject: eCommerce
question: Some products have no sales price and should not be bought online; customers should be invited to contact the company instead. What should be enabled?
options: Prevent Sale of Zero Priced Product
Unpublish all products with a price of 0
Extra Step During Checkout with a contact form
Customer Accounts: Mandatory (no guest checkout)
explanation: "Prevent Sale of Zero Priced Product" ẩn nút Add to Cart cho sản phẩm giá 0 và hiển thị nút Contact Us dẫn tới Button Url. Unpublish thì khách không thấy sản phẩm.

subject: eCommerce
question: A shop needs customers to fill in additional information (e.g. a comment or purchase order number) during checkout before payment. Which setting is used?
options: Customer Accounts: Optional
Abandoned Email
Buy Now
Extra Step During Checkout
explanation: "Extra Step During Checkout" thêm một bước có form tùy chỉnh trong luồng checkout. Buy Now chỉ cho phép mua ngay, bỏ qua giỏ hàng.

subject: eCommerce
question: What does enabling the "Buy Now" option do in Odoo 18 eCommerce?
options: Shows the product in a 'Buy Now' block on the homepage
Adds a button that sends the customer straight to checkout
Replaces the Add to Cart button by a 'Request a Quote' button
Lets customers pay later by invoice instead of online
explanation: "Buy Now" thêm nút mua ngay trên trang sản phẩm, đưa khách thẳng đến checkout. Nút Add to Cart vẫn còn.

subject: eCommerce
question: A wholesaler wants only logged-in users to be able to browse the shop. Which setting should be used?
options: Shared Customer Accounts
Customer Accounts: Mandatory (no guest checkout)
Visibility "Signed In" on each product page
eCommerce Access: Logged in users
explanation: eCommerce Access (All users / Logged in users) giới hạn quyền xem shop. Customer Accounts: Mandatory chỉ bắt đăng nhập lúc checkout, khách vẫn duyệt shop được.

subject: eCommerce
question: A shop wants to show a crossed-out reference price next to the sale price, e.g. "$100" struck through and "$80". What should be enabled?
options: A "Sale" ribbon on the product, set in the website editor
Comparison Price, then fill "Compare to Price"
Display Product Prices: Tax Included
Optional Products
explanation: Bật "Comparison Price" trong Website ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings (mục Shop - Products) rồi nhập "Compare to Price" trên sản phẩm để hiện giá gạch ngang (giá này không hiện khi có pricelist áp dụng). Ribbon "Sale" chỉ là nhãn trên ảnh sản phẩm, không tạo giá gạch ngang.

subject: eCommerce
question: A T-shirt costs $20, but the "XL" size must cost $3 more on the website. How is this configured?
options: An Extra Price of $3 on the "XL" attribute value
Create a delivery method with a $3 surcharge for XL orders
Add a fixed $3 tax applied to the XL size only
Create a separate product "T-shirt XL" at $23
explanation: Mỗi giá trị attribute trên sản phẩm có thể đặt Extra Price cộng vào giá cơ bản của biến thể. Tạo sản phẩm riêng làm mất tính năng chọn biến thể trên cùng trang.

subject: eCommerce
question: All online orders must be assigned to a specific sales team and salesperson for follow-up. Where is this set?
options: In the payment provider form, on its Configuration tab
On each product form, in its eCommerce/Sales tab
Website ‣ Configuration ‣ Settings (Assignment)
In CRM Rule-Based Assignment rules of the sales team
explanation: Website settings có mục Assignment để chọn Sales Team và Salesperson mặc định cho đơn hàng online. Rule-Based Assignment của CRM chỉ phân bổ lead/opportunity.

subject: Project
question: In Odoo 18, a user creates a task from 'My Tasks' without selecting any project. What happens?
options: The task cannot be saved without a project
It becomes a private task, visible only to its assignees
It is automatically added to the 'Internal' project
It is visible to all internal users
explanation: Task không có project là private task, chỉ người được giao (assignees) mới thấy. Odoo 18 không bắt buộc project và không tự đưa vào project Internal.

subject: Project
question: A sales order line uses a service product with the invoicing policy 'Based on Milestones'. What increases the line's delivered quantity so that it can be invoiced?
options: Logging timesheets on the tasks of the milestone
Confirming the sales order
Moving all tasks to a folded stage
Marking the linked milestone as Reached
explanation: Với chính sách Based on Milestones, delivered quantity được cập nhật khi milestone liên kết được đánh dấu Reached (theo % của milestone). Timesheet chỉ ảnh hưởng chính sách Based on Timesheets.

subject: Project
question: When configuring a recurring task in Odoo 18, which options define how long the recurrence lasts?
options: Forever, or Until a given end date
Only a fixed number of repetitions
Until the project's deadline only
Until the related sales order is fully invoiced
explanation: Trường 'Until' của recurrence có hai lựa chọn: Forever hoặc Until (kèm End Date). Odoo 18 không còn tùy chọn số lần lặp cố định.

subject: Project
question: Which Project report shows the evolution over time of the number of tasks in each stage?
options: Tasks Analysis
Customer Ratings
Burndown Chart
Project Updates
explanation: Project ‣ Reporting ‣ Burndown Chart hiển thị số lượng task theo stage theo thời gian. Tasks Analysis là báo cáo phân tích tổng hợp, không thể hiện diễn biến theo stage qua thời gian.

subject: Project
question: A customer contact was added as collaborator of a shared project with the access mode 'Edit with limited access'. What can they do in the portal?
options: Only read tasks, without editing them
View and edit only the tasks they follow
View and edit all tasks of the project, and choose which ones to follow
Edit the project's stages and settings
explanation: 'Edit with limited access' chỉ cho phép xem và sửa các task mà collaborator đang follow. Quyền xem/sửa mọi task là chế độ Edit.

subject: Project
question: A task has 10 hours of Allocated Time and 8 hours of timesheets logged on it. Its progress shows 80%. Where does this progress come from?
options: Timesheet hours logged compared with allocated time
The percentage of its sub-tasks that are closed
The position of the task's current stage in the project pipeline
The completion percentage of the linked milestone
explanation: Progress của task = giờ timesheet đã ghi / Allocated Time. Số sub-task đã đóng hay vị trí stage không ảnh hưởng đến chỉ số này.

subject: Project
question: Every project created from a sales order for the service 'Onboarding Package' must start with the same predefined stages and tasks. What should be configured on the product?
options: A recurring task on the product
The Project Stages setting
A milestone on the product
The 'Project Template' field, pointing to a template project
explanation: Trường Project Template trên product (khi Create on Order là Project hoặc Project & Task) sẽ sao chép project mẫu với stage và task có sẵn. Setting Project Stages chỉ bật stage cho project, không tạo nội dung mẫu.

subject: Timesheets
question: In a project invoiced based on timesheets, each consultant must be billed at a different hourly rate. How is this configured?
options: Create one project per consultant
Map employees to Sales Order Items on the project
Change each employee's Hourly Cost on the HR Settings tab
Assign each consultant a different working schedule
explanation: Bảng mapping employee - Sales Order Item ở tab Invoicing của project cho phép mỗi nhân viên dùng một dòng SO (đơn giá) riêng. Hourly Cost là chi phí nội bộ, không phải giá bán.

subject: Timesheets
question: An employee cannot record time on a specific project from the Timesheets app. What is the most likely cause?
options: The project has no customer
The project has no milestones
The project is not billable
The Timesheets option is not enabled on the project
explanation: Chỉ project đã bật Timesheets mới cho phép ghi timesheet. Project không có customer hay không billable vẫn ghi timesheet được (chỉ là không xuất hóa đơn).

subject: Timesheets
question: When creating an invoice from a sales order whose lines are invoiced based on timesheets, how can you invoice only the timesheets of last month?
options: Set the Timesheets Period in the Create Invoice wizard
Archive the older timesheets before creating the invoice
Change the product's invoicing policy to Prepaid/Fixed Price
Delete the timesheets of the other months
explanation: Wizard Create Invoice cho phép chọn khoảng ngày Timesheets Period để chỉ xuất hóa đơn timesheet trong khoảng đó. Archive hay xóa timesheet làm mất dữ liệu và không phải cách đúng.

subject: Timesheets
question: Which option must be enabled on a project so that its tasks and timesheets can be linked to sales order items and invoiced?
options: Customer Ratings
Recurring Tasks
Billable
Task Dependencies
explanation: Tùy chọn Billable trên project cho phép gắn Sales Order Item vào task/timesheet để xuất hóa đơn. Các tùy chọn còn lại không liên quan đến invoicing.

subject: Timesheets
question: What is the minimum Timesheets access right a user needs to validate the timesheets of other employees?
options: User: own timesheets only
User: all timesheets
Administrator
No specific right: any employee can validate
explanation: Quyền 'User: all timesheets' (approver) đủ để validate timesheet của nhân viên khác. 'User: own timesheets only' chỉ xem/ghi timesheet của chính mình; Administrator thì vượt mức tối thiểu.

subject: Timesheets
question: A timesheet linked to a sales order line has already been invoiced. An employee then tries to change its duration. What happens?
options: The invoice is updated automatically
A credit note is generated automatically
The change is saved and an extra line is added to the next invoice
Odoo blocks the change: the timesheet is already invoiced
explanation: Odoo báo lỗi không cho sửa timesheet đã được xuất hóa đơn để đảm bảo khớp với hóa đơn. Odoo không tự cập nhật hóa đơn hay tạo credit note.

subject: HR
question: Which users can see the Private Information tab on other employees' records?
options: Employees 'Officer: Manage all employees' or higher
All internal users who have access to the Employees app
Only the employee's manager and coach
Portal users
explanation: Thông tin riêng tư (địa chỉ, giấy tờ...) chỉ hiển thị với user có quyền Employees Officer trở lên. Internal user thường chỉ thấy hồ sơ công khai của đồng nghiệp.

subject: HR
question: An employee cannot see their time off dashboard or submit expenses for themselves when logged in. What is the most likely cause?
options: The employee has no department
The employee has no working schedule on the Work Information tab
The employee is not linked to their user (Related User)
The employee has no job position
explanation: Odoo xác định 'nhân viên của tôi' qua liên kết Related User giữa employee và user. Thiếu liên kết này thì các app Time Off/Expenses không nhận ra nhân viên.

subject: HR
question: A company wants to forbid employees from taking time off on its annual inventory day. Which Odoo 18 feature should be used?
options: A public holiday on that day
An accrual plan
Archiving all time off types for that day
A Mandatory Day (Time Off ‣ Configuration ‣ Mandatory Days)
explanation: Mandatory Days là ngày nhân viên không được xin nghỉ phép. Public holiday thì ngược lại: là ngày nghỉ của toàn công ty.

subject: HR
question: In an accrual plan milestone, unused days should be carried over at the carry-over date, but only up to 5 days. Which 'Carry over' option should be selected?
options: None. Accrued time reset to 0
Carry over with a maximum
All accrued time carried over
Set an expiration date on the allocation
explanation: 'Carry over with a maximum' chuyển sang kỳ sau tối đa số ngày quy định. 'All accrued time carried over' chuyển toàn bộ, còn 'None' reset về 0.

subject: HR
question: A recruiter refuses an applicant and wants the candidate to automatically receive a polite rejection email. How is this done?
options: Refuse it with a refuse reason linked to an email template
Delete the applicant record from the job position's pipeline
Move the applicant to the Hired stage
Archive the job position once it is filled
explanation: Nút Refuse cho chọn Refuse Reason, mỗi lý do có thể gắn email template để gửi cho ứng viên. Xóa applicant làm mất lịch sử và không gửi email.

subject: HR
question: An expense report contains only expenses with 'Paid By: Company'. Once its journal entries are posted, what is the next step?
options: Register a payment to reimburse the employee
Wait for the employee to repay the company
None; no reimbursement is needed
It is automatically re-invoiced to a customer
explanation: Chi phí do công ty trả trực tiếp không cần hoàn tiền cho nhân viên nên report được coi là đã thanh toán sau khi post. Register Payment chỉ áp dụng cho 'Employee (to reimburse)'.

subject: HR
question: In kiosk mode, the company wants employees to confirm their identity with a code after selecting their name. Which setting should be enabled?
options: Barcode Source
Attendance From Systray
Display Extra Hours
Employee PIN Identification
explanation: Employee PIN Identification yêu cầu nhập PIN (khai báo trên form nhân viên) khi check-in/out ở kiosk. Barcode Source chỉ chọn thiết bị quét mã.

subject: HR
question: A manager wants colleagues of an employee to fill in a survey to give feedback before the employee's appraisal. Which feature is needed?
options: Interview Forms in Recruitment
360 Feedback in the Appraisals settings
Employee skills
Customer Ratings
explanation: 360 Feedback (dựa trên Surveys) cho phép gửi khảo sát cho đồng nghiệp/người khác để lấy ý kiến cho appraisal. Interview Forms dùng cho tuyển dụng.

subject: Studio
question: Users (without Studio access) must be able to add new 'Equipment Type' values later on. Which field type is the best choice?
options: Selection field listing the current types
Char field with free text
Many2one to a new model
Boolean per equipment type
explanation: Many2one tới một model riêng cho phép user thêm giá trị mới như bản ghi bình thường. Selection có danh sách cố định, chỉ sửa được bằng Studio.

subject: Studio
question: What is specific about the 'On UI change' trigger of an automation rule?
options: It runs on field change in the form, before saving
It runs every night through a scheduled action
It runs only when the record is deleted from the list view
It runs when an incoming email is received on the record
explanation: 'On UI change' hoạt động như onchange: chạy ngay khi user sửa field trên form, trước khi lưu. Các trigger khác (On save, Based on date field...) chạy phía server.

subject: Studio
question: In a custom app built with Studio, you want to add order-line-like sub-records to each record. Which field should be added?
options: Many2many
Selection
Related field
Lines (a one2many to a new line model)
explanation: Field Lines tạo một model con và One2many để quản lý dòng chi tiết như order lines. Many2many liên kết bản ghi có sẵn, không tạo dòng con.

subject: Studio
question: An external system must be able to call Odoo to update records of a custom model. Which automation rule trigger should be used?
options: The 'Send Webhook Notification' action on the record
The 'On webhook' trigger, which provides a URL
The 'After creation' trigger on the custom model
The 'On incoming message' trigger on the model
explanation: Trigger 'On webhook' sinh URL để hệ thống ngoài gọi vào và kích hoạt action trong Odoo. 'Send Webhook Notification' là chiều ngược lại: Odoo gửi dữ liệu ra ngoài.

subject: Studio
question: A field must be required only when the record is in the 'Approved' stage. How can this be done with Studio?
options: Use 'Allow visibility to groups' on the field only
Make the field readonly in the 'Approved' stage
Make it Required with a condition on the stage
Set a default value on the field for that stage
explanation: Thuộc tính Required trong Studio có thể đặt theo điều kiện (domain), ví dụ stage = Approved. Allow visibility to groups chỉ giới hạn hiển thị theo group.

subject: Studio
question: A module exported from Studio is imported into another database. What is required in the target database?
options: Studio must be installed (the module depends on it)
The database must run Odoo Community edition
Developer mode must be disabled during the import
The company must have the same name as in the source
explanation: Module export từ Studio có dependency tới web_studio nên database đích phải cài Studio (Enterprise). Community không có Studio.

subject: Studio
question: You want to rename and reorder an app's menus, or add a menu for an existing model, without writing code. Which Studio tool is used?
options: The report editor
Automation Rules
Approval rules
Edit Menu
explanation: Trong Studio, Edit Menu cho phép đổi tên, sắp xếp và tạo menu mới trỏ tới model. Các công cụ còn lại không quản lý menu.

subject: Studio
question: With Studio, you remove a standard field from a form view. What happens?
options: The field and all its data are deleted from the database
It is only hidden from the view; the field and data remain
All records of the model are archived
The module defining the field is uninstalled automatically
explanation: Xóa field khỏi view chỉ chỉnh view (ẩn field); field và dữ liệu vẫn còn trong database. Studio không xóa field chuẩn khỏi model.

subject: Studio
question: Which Studio field type should be used to store formatted text with bold, lists and images?
options: Text
Char
Html
Selection
explanation: Field Html lưu nội dung có định dạng (rich text, hình ảnh). Text chỉ lưu văn bản thuần nhiều dòng, Char là một dòng.
